arguments.name: code
arguments.description: The activity type code to search for (e.g., "000001"). If provided, searches by EATYPE_CODE field.

raw.name: code
raw.description: The activity type code to search for (e.g., "000001"). If provided, searches by EATYPE_CODE field.

arguments.name: typeName
arguments.description: The activity type name to search for (e.g., "Theatre", "Olympiad"). If provided, searches by EATYPE_NAME field. Either code or typeName must be provided.

raw.name: typeName
raw.description: The activity type name to search for (e.g., "Theatre", "Olympiad"). If provided, searches by EATYPE_NAME field. Either code or typeName must be provided.

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description: If user asks show all / list / available / existing / return all, set this to that phrase to trigger Show All mode.

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description: If user asks show all / list / available / existing / return all, set this to that phrase to trigger Show All mode.

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Page size used while paging (string). Default "10" (UI default).

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description: Page size used while paging (string). Default "10" (UI default).

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description: Safety cap when collecting search results across pages (search mode). String number. Default: "50"

raw.name: maxPages
raw.description: Safety cap when collecting search results across pages (search mode). String number. Default: "50"
